title: Mutation witness and execution flow for agent actions

claims.text: execute reuses a confirmed draft when the fingerprint matches, blocks a second pending submission, and otherwise stamps agent, op_id and expected_head before calling the tool.
witness re-reads the ledger pages for each committed event id and verifies lamport ordering, kind, agent and op_id identity plus the head hash pin.
witness requires run_close payloads to carry gate.passed with every check passed and nonempty memory_receipts, and memory_put payloads to match the submitted unit canonically.
A domain refusal of run_close with memory_required or memory_debt is verified by re-reading the run record, and transport uncertainty leaves the submission in the uncertain phase for replay.

decision.rule: Change here when mutation submission identity, commit witness verification or refusal handling needs to change.
decision.failure: A mutation confirms without a ledger witness, a close gate passes without memory receipts, or a retry mints a new op_id.

questions.q: Where does execute prevent a duplicate pending submission?
Where should I change witness verification of event identity and hash pin?
Where can I debug an unconfirmed mutation witness failure?
How does the flow distinguish refused from uncertain submissions?
